title: Metallic ducts.
officialText:
All metallic ducts shall be constructed as specified in the SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards — Metal and Flexible.
Exception: Ducts installed within single dwelling units shall have a minimum thickness as specified in Table 603.4. DUCT CONSTRUCTION MINIMUM SHEET METAL THICKNESSES FOR SINGLE DWELLING UNITS

Construction Standards, Tables 2-1, 2-2 and 2-3, shall apply.
